title: AnswerJudgement
description: What Evals::Judge returns when it grades an agent's final answer against a rubric (SPEC.md section 12): four 1-5 scores and a one-sentence rationale. The judge sees the tool outputs, so it grades faithfulness to them, not general knowledge.

correctness.description: Does the answer agree with the tool results?

citation.description: Does it cite the handbook (quote or page) where the tool results provide one? 5 if no citation was available to give.

clarity.description: Is it clear and short for a non-technical employee?

no_false_claims.description: Does it avoid claiming actions that did not happen (a request filed, a change made)? 5 means no false claims.

rationale.description: One sentence on the lowest score.
